verdict.rationale: Forter is a fraud-prevention SaaS with SDKs and an MCP server, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. The pack documents no opt-out, privacy toggle, or telemetry-disable setting. Its data-related docs instead push more data collection, such as a strong recommendation to send location updates on every change, and nothing addresses opting out of Forter's own usage tracking.
